defaultProfile.description: ID of the default connection. The dropdown can switch the active connection.

name.description: Display name in the connection dropdown.

protocol.description: Git uses an HTTPS repository and a separate editable local checkout.

host.description: SFTP/FTP server address, without a URL scheme. GitHub is not an SFTP host.

auth.description: agent uses your already loaded SSH key. key reads privateKeyPath. Enter passwords/passphrases in Add / Edit Servers, outside this file.

privateKeyPath.description: Only needed with auth: key. Choose the private key, not its .pub file. Not required with auth: agent.

remotePath.description: Absolute folder on the SFTP/FTP server.

localPath.description: Optional SFTP mirror or a separate Git checkout folder inside this workspace. Git Connect creates the checkout once.

uploadOnSave.description: Local file uploads to SFTP/FTP. Remote SFTP documents already save directly. Git documents save locally and require commit/push.

hostFingerprint.description: Pinned SHA256 SSH server fingerprint. Keep the value verified for your server.

repositoryUrl.description: Git repository HTTPS URL without tokens or passwords. Git uses your existing credential manager.

branch.description: Branch to clone initially. Reconnecting preserves your local branch and edits.
